On Emergency Application for a Stay of the Injunction

CERTIFICATE OF SERVICE
I, Angela Cai, a member of the Bar of  this Court, certify that all parties
required to be served have been served. A copy of the foregoing Brief of 56 Former

as required by U.S. Supreme Court Rule 29.3, on the following:
